ticket.summary: Leaking braided supply hose under bathroom sink; customer closed fixture shutoff, leak fully contained and dry, second bathroom available - needs supply line replacement.
mitigation_advice: Confirmed customer already closed the fixture's shutoff valve under the sink; leave it closed until the tech arrives [PB-01]
If leaking resumes, shut off the house main (clockwise/lever perpendicular) and call us [PB-02]

quote_lines.description: Supply line replacement (braided hose, bathroom sink)

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Jess - 12 Foundry Row, Unit B, tomorrow (Sept 1) at 10:30 AM for the braided supply line replacement, $129 flat rate, about 45 minutes. Leave that shutoff valve closed until the tech arrives [PB-01], and if anything starts leaking again before then, shut off the house main and call us right away [PB-02]. Thanks for the clear info!
